meta.title: Kitletics Pre-Launch Audit 04 — SEO, Crawl & Indexation
productionBuildNotes: Built with `next build --no-lint` and temporary typescript.ignoreBuildErrors due to pre-existing type errors.
tsconfig excluded scripts/ from Next typecheck.

sitemap.note: Sitemap generated via src/app/sitemap.ts using production publication resolver (getProducts/getReviews/etc).

riskEstimate.note: Category pages with query filters set robots noindex + canonicalize to clean category URL (src/app/[sport]/[segment]/page.tsx).
riskEstimate.theoreticalCombinations: If filters were indexable: brands × genders × cushion × stability × sort would be large; live samples should be NOINDEX/CANONICALIZED.

comparisonExplosion.note: generateStaticParams uses editorial getComparisons() only; dynamic pairs are noindex.

menWomen.strategy: Gender is a ProductVariant/audience dimension and catalog filter (?gender=), not separate product URLs.
menWomen.note: Men/Women share /products/{slug}; variants are on-page, not separate indexable URLs.

futureContentTests.navigationNote: Draft entities are excluded from getProducts()/getReviews() production resolver — should not appear in nav cards fed by repositories.
